blocks.text: The module explains why full access tokens were unsafe in stream URLs and defines the short-lived, session-scoped, single-use replacement. It explicitly chooses atomic redemption, direct Redis access, and fail-closed behavior.
blocks.title: Ticket security contract

blocks.text: Constants constrain lifetime, transport kinds, and accepted ticket syntax. _key hashes the raw value, while _redis defers importing the shared Redis object until use.
blocks.title: Ticket storage primitives

blocks.anchor: def issue_ticket(user_id: str, kind: str, session_id: str) -> str:
blocks.text: issue_ticket validates the kind and required identifiers, generates a random ticket, and stores its JSON scope with a thirty-second expiration. A Redis write failure becomes TicketStoreUnavailable.
blocks.title: Issuing scoped tickets

blocks.anchor: def redeem_ticket(ticket: str, kind: str, session_id: str) -> str | None:
blocks.text: redeem_ticket validates syntax before Redis access, consumes the hash with GETDEL, parses the stored scope, and returns the owner only for an exact kind and session match. Invalid data and store errors return None.
blocks.title: Atomic redemption

gotchas: A wrong-kind or wrong-session attempt burns the ticket
how_it_works: Stores user, transport kind, and session under a SHA-256 key
Rejects malformed, expired, reused, or mismatched tickets
outputs: raw ticket or redeemed user id
purpose: Browser WebSocket and EventSource APIs cannot set Authorization headers, so this module replaces full access tokens in query strings with scoped tickets. Only a ticket hash is stored, redemption atomically consumes it, and store failures fail closed for authentication.
summary: Mints short-lived single-use Redis tickets for authenticated WebSocket and SSE stream connections.

raises: ValueError for invalid kind or empty identifiers
symbols.summary: Creates and stores a short-lived ticket scoped to one user, transport, and session.
Atomically consumes a ticket and returns its owner only for the exact requested scope.

unknowns: The route handlers that issue and redeem these values are outside this module.
